results.problem: Streaming graph ANN index maintenance (inserts-only toy setting)
results.bound: L^*(c,T) \le O(\lambda_{\mathrm{ins}} T c^{a-1} N_0^{-b}),\ a-1 \in [0.03, 0.52]\ (95\%\ \mathrm{CI}),\ \hat{a}-1 \approx 0.28
results.quote: so this upper bound is non-decreasing in the merge size c (strictly increasing on the point estimate) and L^*(c) itself is measured non-decreasing directly (§V-B): the naive "batch bigger to amortize" (L^*∝1/c) is wrong in direction.
